content.title: 2026 Oscar Nominated Short Films: Live Action
content.text: Run Time: 119 min. Rating: NR Release Year: 2026 Celebrate Awards Season at Gateway Film Center The Film Center presents the 2026 Oscar-Nominated Short Films, in all three categories: Animation, Documentary, and Live Action. Best Live Action Short Film Nominees (2026) Butcher’s Stain (Israel/United States) Directed by Meyer Levinson-Blount & Oron Caspi — A tense drama that explores workplace pressure and cultural conflict after a damaging allegation upends an Arab-Israeli butcher’s work and personal life. A Friend of Dorothy (United States) Directed by Lee Knight & James Dean — A heartfelt short about connection and identity as characters navigate friendship and belonging in a changing world. Jane Austen’s Period Drama (United Kingdom/United States) Directed by Steve Pinder & Julia Aks — A tongue-in-cheek reimagining that satirizes and celebrates classic storytelling tropes through a sharp, comedic lens. The Singers (United States) Directed by Sam A. Davis & Jack Piatt — A lively and emotional short centered on a group of community vocalists whose bonds are tested by personal and collective challenges. Two People Exchanging Saliva (France/United States) Directed by Alexandre Singh & Natalie Musteata — A bold and provocative piece that uses minimal dialogue and stark visuals to explore intimacy, communication, and human connection. Come join us March 15 as we raise our glasses to toast the winners at The 2026 Awards Season Gala.
